newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Two S.African unions, steel federation sign deal.
newsitem.headline: Two S.African unions, steel federation sign deal.

text.p: Two South African unions signed a wage deal on Monday with the Steel and Engineering Industries Federation (Seifsa), which employers said brought a sector-wide accord for this year nearer to completion.

"The National Union of Metalworkers of South Africa and the Steel, Engineering and Allied Workers' Union of South Africa signed a final settlement agreement with Seifsa in Johannesburg today," Seifsa said in a statement.
"This brings this year's wage negotiation process between the employers and trade unions in the metal and engineering industry closer to a conclusion."
It said seven other unions involved in the negotiations had agreed to refer the same deal to their membership for acceptance or rejection by Friday.
Under the deal, employees will get a wage rise of between nine and 11 percent backdated to the start of July.
